title: IT Ticket Knowledge Base
purpose: Structured IT problem-solution records for retrieval by an Agentic AI or RAG support agent.

tickets.problem_statement: Teams is frozen; buttons do not respond.
solution: Press Ctrl + Shift + Esc to open Task Manager.
Right-click Microsoft Teams and select End task.
Reopen Microsoft Teams and test it again.

tickets.problem_statement: Wi-Fi shows connected, but websites do not open.
solution: Open Command Prompt and run: ipconfig /flushdns
If all devices are affected, restart the router or contact IT support.

tickets.problem_statement: Printer does not print even though the job was sent.
solution: Check printer power and cable or network connection.
Select the printer and review the print queue.
Restart the Print Spooler service if required.

tickets.problem_statement: Windows Update remains stuck at one percentage for a long time.
solution: Keep the computer connected to power and the internet.
Check that enough free storage is available.
Restart the computer if the update is clearly stalled.
Do not force-shutdown the computer during BIOS or firmware updates.

tickets.problem_statement: Outlook is open but new emails are not appearing.
solution: Make sure Work Offline is disabled.
Compare with webmail to determine whether the issue is local to Outlook.
